hardware_target.cpu: Intel Core i3-1115G4 (2 cores, 4 threads, up to 4.10 GHz, 6MB cache)
hardware_target.gpu: Integrated Intel UHD Graphics (consumes ~1-1.5GB system RAM for VRAM)

audio_stability_risk_analysis.prior_claim: Không bao giờ gây gián đoạn hay drop audio buffer
audio_stability_risk_analysis.risk_justification: On an 8GB dual-core i3 machine with integrated GPU sharing RAM, running REAPER with heavy sample-based VSTs pushes total memory to 7.5GB+, dangerously close to OS paging. If Windows begins swapping memory to SSD/HDD pagefile during audio playback, audio buffer underruns (dropouts, clicks, pops) will inevitably occur. Furthermore, CPU spike during heavy music21 chordify or FFT calculation on a 2-core / 4-thread CPU could starve REAPER's real-time audio thread if core affinity is not managed.
audio_stability_risk_analysis.required_action: Retract absolute guarantee. Implement OS thread priority isolation, lazy-loading of music21, and RAM threshold alarms (alerting user if available system RAM falls below 1.2GB).
